observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor guides learners through historical context and visual plates before breaking down the steps step-by-step. She demonstrates the choreography at a steady tempo, combining voiceover instruction with full-body demonstration.

lesson_structure.note: Listen to the music and view fashion plates.
Explanation and demonstration of footwork to a count of four.
Try the dance along with the instructor without music.
Watch the dance performed with music.

Clear visual breakdown of counts before adding music

Take four steps to the left and four steps back to center.
This time try it along with me.
Okay, let's put it all together.
